hum.lantern-bayou.lantern-boat-bump.prompt: Close dry foley recording of a small wooden rowboat gently knocking against a solid timber dock. Several distinct hollow woody thunks, irregularly spaced, with short low resonant decays. Wood hitting wood: a soft clonk, a pause, then two light hollow knocks. The knocking is the only sound. No water recording, no creaking, no squeaking, no birds, no engines, no voices, no music, no wind. Eight seconds of clear quiet wooden impact detail.
